headline: Canada Issues 15-Day Legal Warning to Stelco Over Government Agreement Commitments
summary: Canadian Industry Minister Melanie Joly issued Stelco a 15-day ultimatum to fulfill its agreed commitments with the federal government or face legal action.
why: Stelco is a major North American steelmaker; regulatory compliance and government disputes can disrupt operations or restructuring plans.

impacts.name: Stelco Holdings Inc.
impacts.why: Government legal threats introduce regulatory scrutiny and legal compliance liabilities for the steelmaker.
